description: This file defines an Angular HTTP interceptor class 'GlobalHttpInterceptor' that manages HTTP request handling, error processing, token authentication, and loading state management within an Angular application, specifically for the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: GlobalHttpInterceptor
classes.description: An Angular HTTP interceptor that handles authorization, error handling, request retries, and loading state management for HTTP requests.

methods.name: intercept
methods.description: Main method that intercepts HTTP requests, adds authorization headers if needed, and manages request lifecycle.

methods.name: jwtIntercept
methods.description: Handles adding JWT token to request headers and retries the request.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Executes the HTTP request and handles errors.

methods.name: handleResponseError
methods.description: Processes HTTP errors, manages token refresh, retries, and displays error messages.

methods.name: retryRequest
methods.description: Retries a failed request after a delay.

methods.name: refreshTokenAndRetry
methods.description: Refreshes JWT token and retries the original request.

methods.name: updateAuthorizationHeader
methods.description: Adds JWT token to request headers if available.

methods.name: isTokenBasedAuthEntryPoint
methods.description: Determines if a URL is a token-based authentication entry point.

methods.name: updateLoadingState
methods.description: Manages loading indicator state based on active requests.
